findings.evidence: I12 is the sole hardcoded value in the monthly Overhead roll-forward. The surrounding formulas use prior-month overhead times (1 + Assumptions!$B$18): H12 is 26,709 and the proposed formula produces 26,853, rather than 37,594. The erroneous hardcode causes all subsequent monthly overhead formulas (J12:Z12) to roll forward from the inflated base. Recalculating I:Z reduces overhead by 202,461 in total and the O:Z exit-run-rate EBITDA by 137,142; at the 6.4x multiple this increases enterprise value by 877,709 after rounding.
